items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So she showed up at the club one Sunday and she sang... I said to myself, you know that's a good idea

ctx.x: But in July of '58 you did that South Bay Jazz Festival?

Oh yeah, oh yeah, but by that time I had - oh, I didn't tell you. When I was out in Honolulu I worked at a club there and on Sundays they had jam sessions. So there seemed to be quite a few American musicians who had made Honolulu their home. And there were quite a few female musicians out there. One gal, Ina Rae I didn't even know her name, had been with the Button's band. The all-girl band.
